_meta.comment: As storage writeJson serializes after normalizeHero/Account with post-boot teamBuffs (zeroTeamBuffs merge). Build 35fe328 / W4 T11. BSP-56 (W1): obsHit/obsCrit dropped from both heroes — see storage-legacy-obs-fields.test.ts for discard-on-load coverage. BSP-40 (W2): six "luck":0 insertions (naked/gearedOverride/pts x2 heroes) — luck joins SheetStats, additively normalized on load; see storage-luck-compat.test.ts for the pre-luck legacy-load proof. BSPW5-03 (W5 T2): one "luckFlatPct":0 insertion (tree) — same additive-default pattern as BSP-40, via normalizeAccount's DEFAULT_TREE spread; see account-slice.test.ts for the pre-Wave-5 legacy-load proof. Abisso damage-mult wave: one "abissoBase":0 insertion (tree) — same additive-default pattern, via normalizeAccount's DEFAULT_TREE spread. Glass Cannon numeric wave (selectTreeSheetTotals fix): one "critDmgMult":1 insertion (tree), positioned between abissoBase and luckFlatPct per DEFAULT_TREE's key order — same additive-default pattern; see storage-crit-dmg-mult-compat.test.ts for the pre-wave legacy-load proof. Unspent-points wave: two "statPointsAvailable":0 insertions (HeroRecord, one per hero), positioned right after "pts" per normalizeHero's key order — same additive-default pattern, feeding ReoptInput.statPointsAvailable; see storage-stat-points-available-compat.test.ts for the pre-wave legacy-load proof. MP5 F3 (2026-08-13, AD-083): the 2026-08-13 game patch removed all five keystones — "glassCannon":false, "tempoDobrado":false, "abisso":false, "abissoBase":0, "critDmgMult":1 removed from the tree value (rule-5 stated exception, same shape as obsHit/obsCrit above); see storage-legacy-keystone-fields.test.ts for the pre-removal discard-on-load proof. Farm Ranking (T2): one "maxPhase":null insertion (account, top level), positioned right after "forgeFloor" per normalizeAccount's key order — same additive-default pattern; normalizeAccount is a fixed-field rebuild, so saveAccountShared's normalizeAccount(shared) call injects this field on every write regardless of whether the in-memory AccountSlice/selectAccountShared plumbing (T3) has caught up yet. null (not absent/undefined) is the default for a record with no max_phase source; see account-shared-max-phase.test.ts for the normalize coverage. House-ceiling fix: two insertions (account, top level) — "fieldSlots":null and "houseCycleSecs":null, positioned right after "slots" per normalizeAccount key order, same additive-default pattern as "maxPhase" above. null (not absent) is the default for a record whose save carried no skills.field_slots / casa.cycle_secs: the fallback for fieldSlots is slots, and for houseCycleSecs the HOUSES table, so "known-absent" has to be representable. House-ceiling regression repair (PR #86 finding, house.ts:38): two more insertions — "houseCycleSecsHouseIdx":null and "houseCycleSecsLevel":null, positioned right after "houseCycleSecs" per normalizeAccount key order, same additive-default pattern. This is the (house, level) pair "houseCycleSecs" was captured at, separate from the live "context.houseIdx"/"houseLevel" picker above so a picker move away from the account's own imported house/level actually falls back to the HOUSES table instead of returning a mismatched save figure. XP-multiplier feature: one "xpMult":1 insertion (tree), positioned right after "luckFlatPct" per DEFAULT_TREE's key order — same additive-default pattern; see account-slice.test.ts for the pre-feature legacy-load proof. Issue #132 (team-aura roster derivation): one "teamBuffsOverride" insertion (account, top level), positioned right after "teamBuffs" per normalizeAccount's key order. This legacy record's "teamBuffs" carries a nonzero grito_guerra (2), so normalizeTeamBuffsOverride's migration heuristic reads it as a real prior auto-fill/hand-edit and carries it forward as an explicit override with the same values, rather than the ubiquitous never-touched all-zero default (which migrates to null/derive instead) — see account-slice.test.ts's migration describe block for the null-vs-override proof on both legacy shapes.
